reason: A curated DeepSeek Harness collection providing 1300+ categorized skills and 94 agent definitions, with instructions and a script for installing flattened skills into the Harness skills directory.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按类别整理的 1300 多个技能和 94 个智能体定义，并附带将技能安装到指定目录的工具与说明。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with a categorized collection of over 1,300 skills and 94 agent definitions, plus tools and instructions for installing the skills into a target directory.

capabilities: Provides a curated collection of DeepSeek Harness skills and agent definitions
Organizes skills by category for installation into the DeepSeek Harness skills directory
Includes a shell script and manual copy instructions for flattening nested skill directories
